content:
Maria (CS): hey team — Elytron renewal final routing. they want to switch from PO -> CC but procurement still asking for vendor code and signed SOW. missing: vendor code, signed SOW, billing contact. tagging @Henry (Sales) and @Tom (Legal) for next steps
Henry (Sales): buyer replied — finance can do CC only if we provide vendor code + tax/VAT note. they gave a provisional vendor code 'ELY-UK-01' but said procurement needs legal name + invoice sample
Tom (Legal): okay — we need the delegated signer delegation or a Docusign with corporate seal for EU entity. if they cannot produce, we can accept a CC fallback for 1 invoice but require a commercial invoice with VAT field filled
Jules (Ops): can someone drop the PO snippet they have? i can validate vendor code and wire details once i see full PO lines. also need billing_entity (legal name) and billing email
Maria (CS): paste from buyer DM: 
```
PO#: PO-9802
Bill To: Elytron Limited / Elytron EU LTD
Items:
 - Redwood Inference Platform x150 seats
 - Term: 12mo
Total: GBP 38,400
Billing contact: finance@elytron.co.uk
Vendor Code: ELY-UK-01 (provisional)
```
Maria (CS): buyer says they can attach company registration + bank remit but legal is slow this week
invoice-bot: draft invoice INV-2026 created for review: amount GBP 38,400 — awaiting SOW attachment. link: https://invoices.internal/INV-2026 (internal) :receipt:
Priya (CS): proposal: offer temporary CC tokenization for month 1 to avoid churn, then finalize PO for remaining term. we can prorate month1 and apply PO credit after we receive signed SOW & PO. need sales ok and legal signoff on fallback
Henry (Sales): sales approves CC fallback for first invoice only. below conditions: 1) CC capture only after funnel waiver signed 2) PO must be delivered within 21 days or we apply late PO fee per contract 3) notify renewals queue on capture
Tom (Legal): fine with CC fallback if we get an email acceptance that they will supply PO + delegated signer within 21 days. i'll draft a two-line addendum: short acceptance + PO delivery commitment. i'll drop draft by EOD
Jules (Ops): action items for ops: once we get PO scan we validate vendor code and issue final invoice. if vendor code mismatches, hold and escalate to procurement. i can accept provisional vendor code for CC fallback but need final proof for accounting
Maria (CS): can someone own collecting the delegated signer form? buyer asked if a POC org chart is enough — tom?
Tom (Legal): org chart is ok as interim, but we still need a named signer + email. addendum will list the signer's name to be confirmed.
Maria (CS): i'll ask buyer for signed SOW scan + org chart, and confirm billing email. asked for ETA: buyer said "end of week" but sounded uncertain
Priya (CS): mitigation: schedule enablement on provisional seat count (150) but mark onboarding as contingent on full payment. set onboarding checkpoint 2: once payment clears for month1
Henry (Sales): i'll ping their VP of Finance now. Maria — please tag me on buyer thread so i can escalate.
Maria (CS): pinged buyer, they responded with a quick question about VAT: "we are VAT exempt — do you need our certificate?" i asked them to upload the VAT certificate + company registration.
Tom (Legal): yes please request VAT certificate. we need to attach it to invoice for UK accounting. also confirm if reverse-charge applies.
Jules (Ops): checklist for me: [ ] PO scan (pdf) [ ] Signed SOW (pdf) [ ] VAT cert (pdf) [ ] Billing contact email [ ] Final vendor code match. i'll mark thread when ready
Maria (CS): deadline plan: if we have SOW + PO by Friday 17:00 UTC, proceed with standard renewal flow. if not, enact CC fallback for invoice creation tomorrow and route addendum for signature.
invoice-bot: scheduled: create proforma INV-PRO-2026 for CC capture tomorrow 09:00 UTC if no PO is present by midnight UTC
Priya (CS): noted. i'll prepare a short customer-facing email template offering CC fallback + 21-day PO commitment. posting draft in thread soon. :memo:
Henry (Sales): thanks. if they push back on CC, escalate to me and i'll coordinate procurement call.
Maria (CS): thanks all — i'll update thread when docs arrive. :thumbsup:
